caseNameFull: Wetherell, Speaker of the Florida House of Representatives v. De Grandy De Grandy v. Wetherell, Speaker of the Florida House of Representatives and United States v. Florida

opinions.text: Appeals from D. C. N. D. Fla. Motion of American Jewish Congress et al. for leave to file a brief as amici curiae in No. 92-519 granted. Probable jurisdiction noted, cases consolidated, and a total of one hour allotted for oral argument. Reported below: 815 F. Supp. 1550.
